title: Make it yours: your classroom context
goal: Grade, subject and level make AI output relevant to your class.

blocks.title: Generic in, generic out
blocks.body:
Worksheets feel generic because the AI doesn't know your class.

The fix is simple: tell it. Grade, subject, level, board — even the language you teach in.

blocks.title: Context that matters
blocks.body:
The more you tell AI about your class, the less you'll edit later:

• Grade & subject
• Student level ("they find fractions hard")
• Board / curriculum (CBSE, ICSE, State…)
• Format & length you need

blocks.template:
Make this classroom-ready — pick the context that helps most:

"Explain fractions {{grade}}, {{example}}."

options: with a simple real-life example like sharing a pizza
